name: sys_script_include_7f8e943075b7c3d0d8cbd4f6ea767020

fields.name: SupplierTaskAjax
fields.description: Creates an Incident Task or Catalog Task for a supplier group from SOW.

payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.SupplierTaskAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Creates an Incident Task or Catalog Task for a supplier group from SOW.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>SupplierTaskAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var SupplierTaskAjax = Class.create();
SupplierTaskAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    SUPPLIER_GROUP_TYPE: 'supplier_hub',

    getSuppliers: function() {
        return JSON.stringify(this._suppliers());
    },

    getTaskDefaults: function() {
        var result = {
            suppliers: this._suppliers(),
            short_description: '',
            description: ''
        };
        var parentTable = this._str('sysparm_table');
        if (parentTable != 'incident' && parentTable != 'sc_req_item')
            return JSON.stringify(result);
        var parent = new GlideRecord(parentTable);
        if (parent.get(this._str('sysparm_parent')) && parent.canRead()) {
            result.short_description = parent.getValue('short_description') || '';
            result.description = parent.getValue('description') || '';
        }
        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },

    createTask: function() {
        var parentTable = this._str('sysparm_table');
        var parentId = this._str('sysparm_parent');
        var supplierId = this._str('sysparm_supplier');
        var shortDescription = this._str('sysparm_short_description').trim();
        var description = this._str('sysparm_description');
        var workNotes = this._str('sysparm_work_notes');
        if (parentTable != 'incident' && parentTable != 'sc_req_item')
            return 'error: Unsupported parent table.';
        var parent = new GlideRecord(parentTable);
        if (!parent.get(parentId) || !parent.canWrite())
            return 'error: You do not have permission to update this record.';
        var group = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        if (!group.get(supplierId) || group.active != true || !this._isSupplierGroup(group))
            return 'error: Select an active supplier group.';
        var childTable = parentTable == 'incident' ? 'incident_task' : 'sc_task';
        var child = new GlideRecord(childTable);
        child.initialize();
        if (parentTable == 'incident')
            child.incident = parent.getUniqueValue();
        else
            child.request_item = parent.getUniqueValue();
        child.short_description = shortDescription || parent.getValue('short_description');
        child.description = this._description(parent, parentTable, description);
        child.impact = parent.impact;
        child.urgency = parent.urgency;
        child.priority = parent.priority;
        if (parent.isValidField('service_offering'))
            child.service_offering = parent.service_offering;
        child.assignment_group = group.getUniqueValue();
        if (workNotes)
            child.work_notes = workNotes;
        var childId = child.insert();
        if (!childId)
            return 'error: The supplier task could not be created.';
        var comments = this._existingComments(parent);
        if (comments.length) {
            child.get(childId);
            child.comments = comments.join('\n\n');
            child.update();
        }
        new GlideSysAttachment().copy(parentTable, parent.getUniqueValue(), childTable, childId);
        return 'success:' + child.getValue('number');
    },

    _suppliers: function() {
        var groups = [];
        var typeId = this._supplierTypeId();
        if (!typeId)
            return groups;
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        gr.addActiveQuery();
        gr.addQuery('type', 'CONTAINS', typeId);
        gr.orderBy('name');
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            groups.push({
                displayValue: gr.getValue('name'),
                value: gr.getUniqueValue()
            });
        }
        return groups;
    },

    _supplierTypeId: function() {
        var gt = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group_type');
        gt.addQuery('name', this.SUPPLIER_GROUP_TYPE);
        gt.setLimit(1);
        gt.query();
        return gt.next() ? gt.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },

    _isSupplierGroup: function(group) {
        var typeId = this._supplierTypeId();
        return !!typeId && String(group.getValue('type') || '').indexOf(typeId) > -1;
    },

    _description: function(parent, table, description) {
        var caller = table == 'incident' ? parent.caller_id : parent.requested_for;
        var lines = [];
        if (description)
            lines.push(description, '');
        lines.push('Caller: ' + (caller.getDisplayValue() || ''));
        if (caller.email)
            lines.push('Email: ' + caller.email);
        var phone = String(caller.phone || caller.mobile_phone || '').trim();
        if (phone)
            lines.push('Phone: ' + phone);
        return lines.join('\n');
    },

    _existingComments: function(parent) {
        var notes = [];
        var journal = new GlideRecord('sys_journal_field');
        journal.addQuery('element_id', parent.getUniqueValue());
        journal.addQuery('element', 'comments');
        journal.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        journal.query();
        while (journal.next()) {
            var value = journal.getValue('value');
            if (value)
                notes.push(value);
        }
        return notes;
    },

    _str: function(name) {
        var value = this.getParameter(name);
        return value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value);
    },

    type: 'SupplierTaskAjax'
});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>simen.knudsen@varenergi.no</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-05 09:16:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>7f8e943075b7c3d0d8cbd4f6ea767020</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SupplierTaskAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7f8e943075b7c3d0d8cbd4f6ea767020</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>simen.knudsen@varenergi.no</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-09 07:00:17</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
